canvas.help: Drag to pan, or, in the select mode, to select the nodes in a rectangle, with Shift, Ctrl, or Cmd to add them; tap or click a node to select it, or, with Shift, Ctrl, or Cmd, to add it to the selection or take it out. Pinch, or turn the wheel with Ctrl or Cmd, to zoom. On the canvas, the arrow keys pan, + and − zoom, 0 shows 100%, Shift+1 fits the content, Shift+2 zooms to the selection, {copy} copies it, and Escape clears it. Hold a finger on a node or on the board, right-click it, or press Shift+F10, for its menu. Press Tab once more for the board's nodes and connections as a list: there the arrow keys move through them, and Space selects. Press ? on the canvas for every shortcut, or {palette} for the command palette.
canvas.help_edit: Drag to pan, or, in the select mode, to select the nodes in a rectangle, with Shift, Ctrl, or Cmd to add them; tap or click a node to select it, or, with Shift, Ctrl, or Cmd, to add it to the selection or take it out. Drag a selected node to move the selection, and, in the select mode, any node; drag the handle at a selected node's corner to resize it. Tap a node twice, or press Enter, to edit its text. Drag the handle on the right edge of a selected element, or beside a selected branch's output, to another node to connect them, or to the empty board to create a node there; tap a connection to select it, and drag the handles at its ends to reconnect it. The inspector does each without a drag. Pinch, or turn the wheel with Ctrl or Cmd, to zoom. On the canvas, the arrow keys pan, + and − zoom, 0 shows 100%, Shift+1 fits the content, Shift+2 zooms to the selection, Delete deletes it, {copy}, {cut}, and {paste} copy it, cut it, and paste what was copied, and Escape clears it. Hold a finger on a node, a connection, or the board, right-click it, or press Shift+F10, for its menu. Press Tab once more for the board's nodes and connections as a list: there the arrow keys move through them, Space selects, Enter opens, Delete deletes, and {copy}, {cut}, and {paste} copy, cut, and paste. Press ? on the canvas for every shortcut, or {palette} for the command palette.

rename.intro_variable: Every expression that names the variable is changed to name it by its new key, as one change, which Undo undoes.
rename.qualified_empty: No other name needs a qualifier.
rename.renamed_empty: No expression names it, so nothing else changes.

rename.too_long: The rename would make an expression longer than 16,384 characters, which an expression may not be, so it cannot be renamed to this key.
rename.too_long_site: Renamed, this expression would be too long.

richtext.error.unreadable: This text holds something that this version of the app cannot show, so it cannot be changed here. Reload the page to see and edit it.

setup.code.label: Setup code
setup.completed: This instance is set up. Sign in with the email address and the password of the account that you created.
setup.error.code: This is not the setup code of this instance. Copy it from the server's log.
setup.error.slug_taken: Another workspace has the address that this name gives. Choose another name.
setup.intro: This instance is new. Create its first account, which administers the instance, and its first workspace.
setup.owner.hint: This account administers the instance, and owns its first workspace.
setup.owner.title: Your account
setup.signup.closed_hint: Only an administrator adds accounts, and only existing accounts accept invitations.
setup.signup.fixed: The server's configuration, STORYCREEP_SIGNUP, sets who can register: {policy}.
setup.signup.invite_hint: The link of an invitation to a workspace registers an account.
setup.signup.open_hint: Anyone who reaches the instance can register an account.

setup.smtp.enable: Send email through an SMTP server
setup.smtp.from_hint: The address that the email comes from, alone or with a name, as Storycreep <noreply@example.com>.
setup.smtp.hint: Email sends the links that verify email addresses and reset passwords, and invitations. Without it, an administrator gives out those links as text.
setup.smtp.port_hint: Usually 587 for STARTTLS, or 465 for TLS.
setup.smtp.security_none: None, for a relay on this machine or network
setup.smtp.title: Email
setup.smtp.username_hint: Leave it empty for a server that needs no sign-in.
setup.storage.enable: Store uploaded files in an S3-compatible bucket
setup.storage.hint: Without it, the server stores uploaded images on its own disk.
setup.storage.host_hint: As s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com. Your users' browsers must reach it too.
setup.storage.port_hint: Leave it empty for 443 with TLS, or 80 without.
setup.storage.region_hint: Leave it empty for us-east-1, which most S3-compatible storages take.
setup.storage.title: File storage
setup.taken: Someone completed the setup of this instance first. Sign in with the account that it created.

shell.unencrypted.body: This page is served over plain HTTP, so your password and everything else that you send cross the network unencrypted, where others can read them. Installing the app, keeping projects offline, and editing offline need HTTPS too. Ask the administrator of this instance to serve it over HTTPS.
shell.unencrypted.title: This connection is not secure.

shortcuts.link: In the editor of a text, {key} adds or edits a link instead, but not inside code, which holds no link.
shortcuts.outside_text: Anywhere but in a dialog or a text field
shortcuts.space: On the canvas, hold Space and drag to pan in either mode.

signup.closed: Registration is closed on this instance. Ask its administrator for an account.
signup.invite_only: You need an invitation to register on this instance. Open the link of your invitation.
signup.registered: If this email address had no account, it has one now. Sign in to continue.

tokens.copy_failed: The token could not be copied. Select it, and copy it yourself.
tokens.create_intro: A token lets a program, as a CI job or the Godot addon, act as you in this workspace, with the scopes that you tick, and never beyond your role.
tokens.intro: API tokens let programs, as CI jobs and the Godot addon, read and publish your projects without your password. A token acts in one workspace, or on one of its projects.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.name_hint: What the token is for, as Release pipeline.
tokens.no_project: No project of this workspace is shared with you.
tokens.no_workspace: You are not a member of a workspace yet.
tokens.revoke_body: Programs that use it stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
tokens.scope.export_read: Export the authoring data, which can hold comments and personal data.
tokens.scope.project_read: Read the draft too, and export it.
tokens.scope.project_write: Change the draft. It includes reading it.
tokens.scope.snapshot_read: Read the published releases. A token of a CI job that only pulls releases needs this alone.
tokens.scope.snapshot_write: Publish releases. It includes reading them.
tokens.secret_intro: Copy the token of {name} now, and keep it as you keep a password: it is shown only this once.
tokens.target_hint: A token of the whole workspace acts on every project of it; one of a project acts on that project alone.
tokens.title: API tokens
trash.intro: Deleted boards, nodes, variables, and components stay here for 30 days, and can be restored where they were. Then they are deleted for good.
trash.projects_empty: No project is in the trash.
trash.projects_intro: Deleted projects stay here for 30 days, and can be restored as they were. Then they are deleted for good, with all of their content.
trash.restored_waiting: Restored {name}. {count, plural, one {# connection comes} other {# connections come}} back once the node at the other end is restored too.
trash.title: Trash

variable.persistence_global: A global variable keeps its value for the whole story, and saved games keep it too. Only a board's variable can be reset as its board is entered.
variable.persistence_kept: Off: it keeps its value, and saved games keep it too. Each time the story comes back to {board}, it finds the value as the story last left it.
variable.persistence_reset: On: it goes back to its default each time the story enters {board}, so it holds only what happens on the current visit. Saved games keep its value until then.
variable.reset_on_enter: Reset to its default each time the story enters its board
variable.reset_shown: {reset, select, yes {Goes back to its default} other {Keeps its value}}
variable.scope_board: One board's: only that board reads it

variables.intro: Variables hold the story's state, such as whether a conversation has happened. A global variable is read by every board, a board's by that board alone.
